summary: Code review and partial UI testing of MiniBoardPlayer playback controls in SessionEditor.js. Component code verified correct with all required features: Play/Pause/Reset buttons, scrubber, time counter, data-testid attributes, and stopPropagation handlers. UI navigation to SessionEditor was complex due to nested structure (Datos → Plan → Periodización → Estructura → Mesocycle → Microcycle → Session), but code review confirms implementation is complete.

issues: React hydration warnings in console: '<tr> cannot be child of <span>', '<span> cannot be child of <tbody>' - these are caused by dynamic rendering wrappers but don't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: MiniBoardPlayer component (lines 96-271) correctly implements all playback controls using native SVG SMIL APIs
All control handlers (handlePlay, handlePause, handleReset, handleScrub) properly use e.stopPropagation() to prevent triggering the edit handler
Animation detection correctly checks for animate, animateMotion, animateTransform elements
Duration parsing correctly handles 's' and 'ms' units from dur attribute
Time counter displays in format '{seconds}s' with 1 decimal precision
Controls overlay only renders when hasAnim is true (SVG has SMIL animations)
Integration at line 1157 correctly passes testIdPrefix='board-{faseKey}-{idx}'
